candidates.source: 原来是乌龟 虾米二将 俺老孙要见老龙王 快快通报
candidates.target: It's me, Sun Wukong. I want to see the Old Dragon King. Please announce me quickly.

candidates.source: 原来是乌龟 虾米二将 俺老孙要见老龙王 快快通报
candidates.target: So it was the Turtle and the Shrimp! Old Sun Wukong is going to see the Dragon King. Quickly report this!

candidates.source: 原来是乌龟 虾米二将 俺老孙要见老龙王 快快通报
candidates.target: Turns out it's the Tortoise and Shrimp Generals. Old Sun wants to see the Dragon King! Quickly report it!

candidates.source: 原来是乌龟 虾米二将 俺老孙要见老龙王 快快通报
candidates.target: So it's the Turtle and the Shrimp Generals! I, the Great Sage, wish to see the Old Dragon King. Announce my presence at once!

candidates.source: 原来是乌龟 虾米二将 俺老孙要见老龙王 快快通报
candidates.target: It's the turtle and shrimp generals! I, the Old Monkey, wish to see the Dragon King. Announce my arrival quickly!

candidates.source: 原来是乌龟 虾米二将 俺老孙要见老龙王 快快通报
candidates.target: So it's General Turtle and General Shrimp. I need to see the Dragon King. Please tell him quickly.

candidates.source: 俺老孙上天入地无所不能 哪儿有去不得的地方
candidates.target: I, Sun Wukong, can go anywhere, whether in the heavens or underground. Where can't I go?

candidates.source: 俺老孙上天入地无所不能 哪儿有去不得的地方
candidates.target: Old Sun, I, can do anything under and above the heavens; there's nowhere I can't go.

candidates.source: 俺老孙上天入地无所不能 哪儿有去不得的地方
candidates.target: I, Sun Wukong, can go anywhere, both heaven and earth – there's no place I can't reach.

candidates.source: 俺老孙上天入地无所不能 哪儿有去不得的地方
candidates.target: I, Old Sun, can traverse heaven and earth with boundless power; is there any place I cannot go?

candidates.source: 俺老孙上天入地无所不能 哪儿有去不得的地方
candidates.target: I, the Great Sage, can ascend to heaven and descend to earth; there is no place I cannot reach.

candidates.source: 俺老孙上天入地无所不能 哪儿有去不得的地方
candidates.target: I can fly up to Heaven and burrow into the deepest ground. There's no place I can't go.

candidates.source: 力能降龙伏虎 移山倒海 万岁切不可轻视啊
candidates.target: The power to subdue dragons and tigers, to move mountains and overturn seas, must never be underestimated.

candidates.source: 力能降龙伏虎 移山倒海 万岁切不可轻视啊
candidates.target: With strength enough to subdue dragons and tigers, and move mountains and seas, long may you live, but never underestimate [this/it]!

candidates.source: 力能降龙伏虎 移山倒海 万岁切不可轻视啊
candidates.target: Strength can subdue dragons and tigers, move mountains and overturn the seas. Long live [the emperor/a powerful figure], but must never be taken lightly!

candidates.source: 力能降龙伏虎 移山倒海 万岁切不可轻视啊
candidates.target: His power can subdue dragons and tigers, move mountains, and overturn seas. Your Majesty must never underestimate him.

candidates.source: 力能降龙伏虎 移山倒海 万岁切不可轻视啊
candidates.target: With power to subdue dragons and tigers, move mountains and overturn seas, the Ten-Thousand-Year Emperor must never be underestimated.

candidates.source: 力能降龙伏虎 移山倒海 万岁切不可轻视啊
candidates.target: He can subdue tigers and dragons, move mountains, and empty seas. Your majesty, you can't take it lightly.

candidates.source: 不费一兵一卒 把他哄上天来严加管束 如不服管 也好就地擒拿
candidates.target: Without sending a single soldier or moving a single weapon, we can bring him to heel through deception and strict control. If he refuses to submit, we can capture him on the spot.

candidates.source: 不费一兵一卒 把他哄上天来严加管束 如不服管 也好就地擒拿
candidates.target: Without expending a single soldier or troop, lure him up here and strictly control him. If he resists control, then simply capture him on the spot.

candidates.source: 不费一兵一卒 把他哄上天来严加管束 如不服管 也好就地擒拿
candidates.target: Without deploying a single soldier, lure him here and strictly control him. If he refuses to be controlled, simply arrest him on the spot.

candidates.source: 不费一兵一卒 把他哄上天来严加管束 如不服管 也好就地擒拿
candidates.target: Without deploying a single soldier, we shall coax him to ascend to the heavens and place him under strict supervision; should he refuse to comply, we can apprehend him on the spot.

candidates.source: 不费一兵一卒 把他哄上天来严加管束 如不服管 也好就地擒拿
candidates.target: Without losing a single soldier, coax him up to the heavens for strict supervision; should he refuse to obey, arrest him on the spot.

candidates.source: 不费一兵一卒 把他哄上天来严加管束 如不服管 也好就地擒拿
candidates.target: We'll restrain the monkey here in Heaven, and it will be easy for us to capture him, if he commits crimes.

candidates.source: 众位仙姑驾到 小神未曾远迎 有罪有罪
candidates.target: The immortal ladies have arrived. This lowly spirit did not go far enough to greet them. I am guilty, I am guilty.

candidates.source: 众位仙姑驾到 小神未曾远迎 有罪有罪
candidates.target: Respected Immortal Matrons have arrived. This humble one failed to greet you properly. I am at fault, at fault.

candidates.source: 众位仙姑驾到 小神未曾远迎 有罪有罪
candidates.target: Honorable immortals, your arrival is graced upon us. This humble spirit did not greet you from afar, a great offense, a great offense.

candidates.source: 众位仙姑驾到 小神未曾远迎 有罪有罪
candidates.target: The fair immortals have arrived; this humble deity failed to welcome you from afar. I am at fault, truly at fault.

candidates.source: 众位仙姑驾到 小神未曾远迎 有罪有罪
candidates.target: May the fairies arrive! This humble deity failed to welcome you from afar; I am guilty, I am guilty.

candidates.source: 众位仙姑驾到 小神未曾远迎 有罪有罪
candidates.target: The goddesses are here. I didn't come to greet you, please forgive me.

candidates.source: 大胆弼马温 你眼睛里还有没有玉帝呀
candidates.target: Bold and fearless, is the Jade Emperor still in your eyes?

candidates.source: 大胆弼马温 你眼睛里还有没有玉帝呀
candidates.target: Bold official, do you still see the Jade Emperor in your eyes?

candidates.source: 大胆弼马温 你眼睛里还有没有玉帝呀
candidates.target:
Bold Sun Wukong, do you still have any respect for the Jade Emperor in your eyes? 

(Or, a more colloquial translation: Bold Monkey King, have you lost all respect for the Jade Emperor?)

candidates.source: 大胆弼马温 你眼睛里还有没有玉帝呀
candidates.target: Bold Bimawen, do you still have the Jade Emperor in your eyes?

candidates.source: 大胆弼马温 你眼睛里还有没有玉帝呀
candidates.target: Bold Monkey King, do you still have any respect for the Jade Emperor in your eyes?

candidates.source: 大胆弼马温 你眼睛里还有没有玉帝呀
candidates.target: How dare you? Do you have any respect for the Jade Emperor?

candidates.source: 万岁 待贫道相助二郎真君一臂之力
candidates.target: Long live! Allow me to lend a hand to the Second Lord of the Earth.

candidates.source: 万岁 待贫道相助二郎真君一臂之力
candidates.target: Long live! Allow this humble one to assist with the true power of the Second Young Master.

candidates.source: 万岁 待贫道相助二郎真君一臂之力
candidates.target: Long live the Emperor! Wait for this humble Daoist to assist, and receive the strength of Erlang Shen!

candidates.source: 万岁 待贫道相助二郎真君一臂之力
candidates.target: Long live the Emperor! Allow this humble Daoist to lend a hand to the True Lord Erlang.

candidates.source: 万岁 待贫道相助二郎真君一臂之力
candidates.target: Long live! Let me lend my aid to the Second Lord Erlang.

candidates.source: 万岁 待贫道相助二郎真君一臂之力
candidates.target: Your Majesty, let me, a poor monk, aid Erlang.

candidates.source: 俺在这花果山上就是齐天大圣 谁用他封
candidates.target: I am the Great Sage Equaling Heaven on this Flower-Fruit Mountain. Who dares to seal me?

candidates.source: 俺在这花果山上就是齐天大圣 谁用他封
candidates.target: I am the Great Sage Equal to Heaven on Flower Fruit Mountain. Who used him to seal me?

candidates.source: 俺在这花果山上就是齐天大圣 谁用他封
candidates.target: I am the Great Sage Equal to Heaven on this Huaguo Mountain. Who dares to seal me?

candidates.source: 俺在这花果山上就是齐天大圣 谁用他封
candidates.target: On this Flower-Fruit Mountain, I am the Great Sage Equal to Heaven. Who needs their titles to define me?

candidates.source: 俺在这花果山上就是齐天大圣 谁用他封
candidates.target: I am the Great Sage Equal to Heaven on this Flower-Fruit Mountain; who needs his title?

candidates.source: 俺在这花果山上就是齐天大圣 谁用他封
candidates.target: I'm already The Great Sage here at the Mountain of Flowers and Fruits. I don't need him to appoint me.

candidates.source: 你们背地里下手 暗箭伤人 算不得什么好汉
candidates.target: You're nothing but a coward, striking from behind and shooting arrows in the dark.

candidates.source: 你们背地里下手 暗箭伤人 算不得什么好汉
candidates.target: Those who strike from behind and injure others with hidden arrows are not honorable men.

candidates.source: 你们背地里下手 暗箭伤人 算不得什么好汉
candidates.target:
You strike from the shadows and harm people with hidden arrows – you are no heroes. 

(Or, more colloquially: You stab people in the back – you're no honorable men.)

candidates.source: 你们背地里下手 暗箭伤人 算不得什么好汉
candidates.target: You strike from the shadows and wound with hidden arrows; that does not make you a true hero.

candidates.source: 你们背地里下手 暗箭伤人 算不得什么好汉
candidates.target: You act treacherously behind our backs and strike with hidden arrows; you cannot be called a true hero.

candidates.source: 你们背地里下手 暗箭伤人 算不得什么好汉
candidates.target: How despicable to stab me in the back. It's not very heroic. Humpf!

candidates.source: 不如将计就计 就给他个齐天大圣的空名
candidates.target: Why don't we turn his trick against him and give him the empty title of "Great Sage, Equal of Heaven"?

candidates.source: 不如将计就计 就给他个齐天大圣的空名
candidates.target: Why not play his game and just give him the empty title of Great Sage Equal to Heaven?

candidates.source: 不如将计就计 就给他个齐天大圣的空名
candidates.target: Why not turn his scheme against him and just give him the empty title of "Great Sage Equal to Heaven"?

candidates.source: 不如将计就计 就给他个齐天大圣的空名
candidates.target: Better to play along with his scheme and grant him the empty title of the Great Sage Equal to Heaven.

candidates.source: 不如将计就计 就给他个齐天大圣的空名
candidates.target: Might as well play along and give him the empty title of the Great Sage Equal to Heaven.

candidates.source: 不如将计就计 就给他个齐天大圣的空名
candidates.target: Let's beat him at his own game.

candidates.source: 若不依他 就要打上凌霄宝殿
candidates.target: If you don't follow his orders, you'll be sent to the Celestial Palace for punishment.

candidates.source: 若不依他 就要打上凌霄宝殿
candidates.target: If you don't listen to him, he'll have you climb the Azure Ladder to Heaven.

candidates.source: 若不依他 就要打上凌霄宝殿
candidates.target:
If he doesn't listen, I will fight my way to the Imperial Palace. 

(Or, more figuratively: If he doesn't comply, I will take this all the way to the top/highest authority.)

candidates.source: 若不依他 就要打上凌霄宝殿
candidates.target: If we do not rely on him, we shall storm the Hall of the Highest Void.

candidates.source: 若不依他 就要打上凌霄宝殿
candidates.target: If you do not submit to him, I will strike you down before the Hall of Supreme Purity.

candidates.source: 若不依他 就要打上凌霄宝殿
candidates.target: If we don't accommodate him, he plans to attack the Heavenly Palace!

candidates.source: 如不抓来严加惩办 定会有人学他 天上岂不大乱
candidates.target: If we don't severely punish him, others will follow his example, and the heavens will be in chaos.

candidates.source: 如不抓来严加惩办 定会有人学他 天上岂不大乱
candidates.target: If he isn't severely punished, others will surely follow suit, and chaos will reign in the heavens.

candidates.source: 如不抓来严加惩办 定会有人学他 天上岂不大乱
candidates.target: If he isn't arrested and severely punished, others will follow his example, and wouldn't that throw Heaven into chaos?

candidates.source: 如不抓来严加惩办 定会有人学他 天上岂不大乱
candidates.target: If he is not apprehended and severely punished, others will surely emulate him, and chaos will surely ensue in the heavens.

candidates.source: 如不抓来严加惩办 定会有人学他 天上岂不大乱
candidates.target: If we do not arrest him and punish him severely, others will surely follow his example, and chaos will ensue in heaven.

candidates.source: 如不抓来严加惩办 定会有人学他 天上岂不大乱
candidates.target: If we don't punish him severely, others may follow his example. The world will be in havoc!

candidates.source: 是啊 太扫兴了 大王要件称手合用的兵器嘛 倒也不难
candidates.target: Yes, it's quite a shame. It's not hard to find a weapon that suits the king's needs.

candidates.source: 是啊 太扫兴了 大王要件称手合用的兵器嘛 倒也不难
candidates.target: Yes, that's disappointing. A great king needs a weapon that fits his hand, doesn't he? Not difficult at all.

candidates.source: 是啊 太扫兴了 大王要件称手合用的兵器嘛 倒也不难
candidates.target: Yeah, it's really a letdown. If the Great King wants a weapon that fits his hand and is useful, that's not difficult at all.

candidates.source: 是啊 太扫兴了 大王要件称手合用的兵器嘛 倒也不难
candidates.target: Indeed, it's quite disappointing. Yet, if the Great King seeks a weapon that is well-suited and easy to wield, that is not difficult to arrange.

candidates.source: 是啊 太扫兴了 大王要件称手合用的兵器嘛 倒也不难
candidates.target: Yes, it is indeed disappointing. However, it is not difficult for the Great King to obtain a weapon that is both practical and suitable.

candidates.source: 是啊 太扫兴了 大王要件称手合用的兵器嘛 倒也不难
candidates.target: If the King wants to find a good weapon, it isn't very difficult.

candidates.source: 噢 那妖猴好生了得 他是五百年前得道的猴精
candidates.target: Oh, that monkey is extraordinary. He is a monkey spirit who attained enlightenment 500 years ago.

candidates.source: 噢 那妖猴好生了得 他是五百年前得道的猴精
candidates.target: Oh, that demon monkey is quite capable. He's a monkey spirit who attained enlightenment five hundred years ago.

candidates.source: 噢 那妖猴好生了得 他是五百年前得道的猴精
candidates.target: Oh, that demon monkey is truly remarkable! He is a monkey spirit who achieved enlightenment five hundred years ago.

candidates.source: 噢 那妖猴好生了得 他是五百年前得道的猴精
candidates.target: Oh, that demon monkey is truly formidable; he is a monkey spirit who attained the Dao five hundred years ago.

candidates.source: 噢 那妖猴好生了得 他是五百年前得道的猴精
candidates.target: Oh, that demon monkey is truly formidable! He is a monkey spirit who attained enlightenment five hundred years ago.

candidates.source: 噢 那妖猴好生了得 他是五百年前得道的猴精
candidates.target: That's a long story. He's a Taoist monkey born 500 years ago.

candidates.source: 量你这小小毛神有何法力 胆敢出此狂言
candidates.target: How dare you, a mere hair spirit, utter such audacious words?

candidates.source: 量你这小小毛神有何法力 胆敢出此狂言
candidates.target: What power could you, a mere fledgling, possibly possess to utter such audacious words?

candidates.source: 量你这小小毛神有何法力 胆敢出此狂言
candidates.target:
How much power could a minor spirit like you possibly possess, to dare utter such arrogant words? 

(Or, a more dramatic/literary translation:)

What power do you, a small, insignificant spirit, wield, to dare speak such wild boasts?

candidates.source: 量你这小小毛神有何法力 胆敢出此狂言
candidates.target: What power could a mere fledgling spirit like you possibly possess to dare utter such arrogant words?

candidates.source: 量你这小小毛神有何法力 胆敢出此狂言
candidates.target: How dare you, mere hair god, speak such arrogant words? What powers do you possess?

candidates.source: 量你这小小毛神有何法力 胆敢出此狂言
candidates.target: What can a small god like you do? How dare you talk so much rubbish?

candidates.source: 既然玉帝请俺老孙上天 为什么还要动刀动枪的
candidates.target: Since the Jade Emperor invited me, Sun Wukong, to the heavens, why is there a need for swords and guns?

candidates.source: 既然玉帝请俺老孙上天 为什么还要动刀动枪的
candidates.target: Since the Jade Emperor invited me, Lao Sun, to the heavens, why are you still wielding swords and spears?

candidates.source: 既然玉帝请俺老孙上天 为什么还要动刀动枪的
candidates.target: Since the Jade Emperor invited me, Sun Wukong, to Heaven, why are you still resorting to weapons and violence?

candidates.source: 既然玉帝请俺老孙上天 为什么还要动刀动枪的
candidates.target: Since the Jade Emperor has invited me, the Great Sage, to ascend to heaven, why must weapons be drawn?

candidates.source: 既然玉帝请俺老孙上天 为什么还要动刀动枪的
candidates.target: Since the Jade Emperor invited me, Old Sun, to ascend to heaven, why must we resort to weapons and violence?

candidates.source: 既然玉帝请俺老孙上天 为什么还要动刀动枪的
candidates.target: The Jade Emperor invited me to Heaven. Why are you so aggressive?

candidates.source: - 猴头 炉子里滋味如何呀
candidates.target: - How does the monkey's head taste in the stove?

candidates.source: - 猴头 炉子里滋味如何呀
candidates.target: How's the flavor coming along in the monkey head stove?

candidates.source: - 猴头 炉子里滋味如何呀
candidates.target: How does monkey head mushroom taste cooked in the stove?

candidates.source: - 猴头 炉子里滋味如何呀
candidates.target: - Monkey Head, how's the taste in the furnace?

candidates.source: - 猴头 炉子里滋味如何呀
candidates.target: - Monkey Head, how does the flavor taste in the furnace?

candidates.source: - 猴头 炉子里滋味如何呀
candidates.target: Monkey, how do you like it in the furnace?

candidates.source: 哼 好啊 我叫你好好凉快 好好地舒服
candidates.target: Hmph, fine. I'll make sure you cool off and relax properly.

candidates.source: 哼 好啊 我叫你好好凉快 好好地舒服
candidates.target: Hmph, fine. I'll make you cool and comfortable.

candidates.source: 哼 好啊 我叫你好好凉快 好好地舒服
candidates.target:
Hmph, fine. I'll make you suffer. Enjoy being comfortable (sarcastically). 

Or, a more colloquial translation:

Hmph, alright then. You'll regret this. Enjoy! (said with heavy sarcasm)

candidates.source: 哼 好啊 我叫你好好凉快 好好地舒服
candidates.target: Hmph, fine. I'll make sure you get thoroughly chilled and wonderfully comfortable.

candidates.source: 哼 好啊 我叫你好好凉快 好好地舒服
candidates.target: Hmph, very well. I'll make sure you stay cool and feel comfortable.

candidates.source: 哼 好啊 我叫你好好凉快 好好地舒服
candidates.target: Heh! Okay, I made it too cool and too comfortable...

candidates.source: 在你这么大的东洋大海 连件称手的兵器也找不到吗
candidates.target: In this vast ocean of the East, can't you find even a single weapon that suits your hand?

candidates.source: 在你这么大的东洋大海 连件称手的兵器也找不到吗
candidates.target: In such a vast Eastern ocean as yours, can't you even find a single usable weapon?

candidates.source: 在你这么大的东洋大海 连件称手的兵器也找不到吗
candidates.target: In such a vast eastern sea, can't you even find a decent weapon?

candidates.source: 在你这么大的东洋大海 连件称手的兵器也找不到吗
candidates.target: In such a vast Eastern sea, can you not find a single weapon that suits you?

candidates.source: 在你这么大的东洋大海 连件称手的兵器也找不到吗
candidates.target: In such a vast ocean of the Eastern Barbarians, can you not find a weapon that suits your hand?

candidates.source: 在你这么大的东洋大海 连件称手的兵器也找不到吗
candidates.target: Your Eastern Sea is so huge... and yet you can't find me a perfect weapon?

candidates.source: 这是给玉帝炼的金丹 俺先尝尝什么滋味
candidates.target: This is the golden pill forged for the Jade Emperor. I'll taste it first to see what it's like.

candidates.source: 这是给玉帝炼的金丹 俺先尝尝什么滋味
candidates.target: This is an elixir refined for the Jade Emperor. Let me taste what it's like first.

candidates.source: 这是给玉帝炼的金丹 俺先尝尝什么滋味
candidates.target: This is the golden pill refined for the Jade Emperor. Let me taste what it's like first.

candidates.source: 这是给玉帝炼的金丹 俺先尝尝什么滋味
candidates.target: This is the Golden Elixir I've refined for the Jade Emperor. Let me taste it first to see how it is.

candidates.source: 这是给玉帝炼的金丹 俺先尝尝什么滋味
candidates.target: This is the golden pill refined for the Jade Emperor. Let me taste it first to see what it's like.

candidates.source: 这是给玉帝炼的金丹 俺先尝尝什么滋味
candidates.target: It's the Golden Elixir Pill for the Jade Emperor. Let me have a taste.

candidates.source: 这是禹王治水时 留下来的一根定海神针
candidates.target: This is a legendary needle left by Yu the Great during his flood control project.

candidates.source: Right so, a fine notice.  Rubik's mother-twice, she were a woman o'th'old kind.  And were her mate, and Rubik's father-twice.  Rubik's father-mother, she were a gran, a fitty bit of ol' London-Town, right so, but Rubik had a jaryi and a taita and a tamoi." Rubik's voice goes distant for a moment.  "An' they was all there, right to the end.  Standin' by, we were, one and all." They pause, then seem to snap back.  "No time for stories, kennit?  Back to the here an' now.
candidates.target: 好的，一个好消息。魔方母亲两次，她是老一辈的妇女。她的伴侣，也是魔方父亲两次。魔方父亲的母亲，她是一个老伦敦城的老奶奶，就是这样，但魔方有一个姐姐，一个哥哥，和一个妹妹。”魔方的声音暂时变远了。“他们都在，直到最后。我们都站在那里，全体。”他们停顿了一下，然后似乎又回过神来。“没有时间讲故事吗？回到现在吧。
